# Feature Request: Expose `crypto.subtle.timingSafeEqual` in the Workers runtime#7257
## Description
fbwe425

## Feature Request
### Summary
Please expose `crypto.subtle.timingSafeEqual(a, b)` as part of the Web Crypto API surface in `workerd` / Cloudflare Workers.

### Motivation

### Proposed API
Align with the WHATWG proposal and Node.js `crypto.timingSafeEqual`:

### Why workerd specifically
- `workerd` already exposes `crypto.subtle` — this is a small, self-contained addition

### References
- Node.js `crypto.timingSafeEqual`: [https://nodejs.org/api/crypto.html#cryptotimingsafeequala-b](https://nodejs.org/api/crypto.html#cryptotimingsafeequala-b)

It's already implemented. [https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/main/src/workerd/api/crypto/crypto.h#L602](https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/main/src/workerd/api/crypto/crypto.h#L602)
For Cloudflare Workers, we are looking at the possibility of implementing crypto.subtle.timingSafeEqual(a, b) as an extension to SubtleCrypto
